# SVG Studio

Make vectors production-ready, optimize, convert, generate and inspect SVG: shrink files, produce React components or data URIs, trace raster art, craft blobs and waves.

30 tools. Each name opens the tool on gigai.tools, where its page explains how to use it step by step.

| Tool | What it does | Input | Output | Runs |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Data URI to SVG](https://gigai.tools/data-uri-to-svg) | Paste a data:image/svg+xml URI and get the original SVG back: base64 or URL-encoded, decoded instantly with a live preview and a clean.svg download. 100% in your browser. | Data URI | SVG | Browser |
| [PNG to SVG](https://gigai.tools/png-to-svg) | Drop a PNG, JPG or WebP and watch it become editable SVG paths, tune colors and detail, compare raster and vector side by side, then copy or download. Best on flat logos and icons, 100% in your browser. | PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF, BMP | SVG | Browser |
| [SVG Animation Generator](https://gigai.tools/svg-animation-generator) | Paste an SVG, choose a preset, and watch it come alive. Dial in the duration, easing, delay and loop count, preview it on any background, then copy a single self-contained animated SVG, or just the CSS keyframes. All in your browser, no sign-up, no watermark. | SVG | SVG, CSS | Browser |
| [SVG Background Generator](https://gigai.tools/svg-background-generator) | Choose a style, set the aspect ratio, drop in your brand colors, and get a full-bleed background as clean, scalable SVG. Re-roll for a fresh layout, then copy the SVG or a ready-to-paste CSS snippet: every layout comes from a seed you can reproduce, entirely in your browser. |  | SVG, CSS, PNG | Browser |
